about_short_description.short_description: Simplify is a common application for jobs and internships.

product.name: Simplify
product.description: An AI-assisted job and internship search platform that matches candidates with roles, supports applications, helps tailor resumes, and organizes job-search activity in one account.

product.name: Simplify Copilot
product.description: A browser extension that autofills job applications, generates responses to job-specific questions, analyzes resume keywords, and automatically records submitted applications.

product.name: Simplify+
product.description: A paid subscription that provides additional AI-based features for job searching and application preparation beyond Simplify's free tools.

product.name: Simplify Employer Recruiting Platform
product.description: A hiring marketplace and employer service that lets companies post roles, promote openings, reach candidate profiles, and customize company career pages.
